beats.text: Streams never end: cut them into windows.
beats.say: Streams never end, so to count or sum anything, you have to cut them into windows. There are three main kinds.
Tumbling windows are fixed-size and never overlap. Every event belongs to exactly one window.
Sliding windows are also fixed-size, but they overlap, moving forward in smaller steps. So one event can be counted in several windows.

beats.text: Session: open while events keep coming.
beats.say: Session windows follow activity. A window stays open as long as events keep coming, and closes after a gap of inactivity.
Use tumbling for simple reports, sliding for moving averages, and session windows for user behavior.
